note: Curated, human-reviewed observations. Derived flags are appended by tools/flags.py on every build. Every item states what was actually checked and, where it could not be re-checked, says so instead of asserting it.

flags.item: The scheduled refresh stopped on 2026-10-25 because three test fixtures hardcoded a date that crossed the 24 h receipt window
flags.detail: Run 40189452274 (2026-10-25T11:34Z) failed at 'Stop on failed gate' with data/build_failed_steps.txt = unit-tests. The publish gate itself was green: tools/verify.py passed all 48 checks in that same run. The failing stage was the unit tests: tests/test_corroborate_history.py and tests/test_corroborate_offlist.py build receipt fixtures with a hardcoded captured_utc of 2026-10-24T00:00Z, and tools/corroborate.py measures a capture against the wall clock (RECEIPT_MAX_AGE_HOURS = 24). Once that literal aged past 24 h the receipts were classified 'expired' instead of 'usable' and three assertions inverted, so every scheduled run after ~2026-10-25T00:00Z would fail until the calendar moved. Fixed by generating the fixtures relative to now; the assertions are unchanged, so a real classification bug still fails the suite. The failing log is archived at data/diag/failure-2026-10-25T1134Z.log, and a green run now clears data/build_failed_steps.txt. Consequence to note for review: the published snapshot is 2026-10-24T20:54Z, i.e. older than one 6 h cycle, until the next green refresh publishes.
flags.verification: verified 2026-10-25 against the failing job's step list, data/build_failed_steps.txt and data/diag/failure-2026-10-25T1134Z.log

flags.item: The six-hourly refresh failed for 24 hours because receipts for delisted fixtures were counted as rejected
flags.detail: Hotspawn's fixtures API only returns cards with status=scheduled and drops a card once it kicks off, so a static external-odds receipt points at a fixture that is no longer listed within a day. tools/corroborate.py classified those as 'unmatched / rejected', and the publish gate 'external receipts validated against the dataset' fails whenever any receipt is rejected. Every scheduled refresh from 2026-10-23T17:13Z to 2026-10-24T16:19Z therefore failed at the gate (40 of 41 checks passing) and the published site stayed frozen at the 2026-10-23T17:13:12Z snapshot. Fixed in PR #62: such a receipt is now classified as historical evidence, kept and dated on the coverage page, excluded from every price and from the gate, which still fails on malformed receipts and on receipts that name the wrong teams for a fixture we do list. The first green run after the fix is 40110996859 (2026-10-24T16:19Z, 241/241 fixtures, 41/41 gates, 16 historical receipts).
flags.verification: verified 2026-10-24 against the failing run's own log and the green run after the fix

flags.item: Two market rows publish venue weights that do not sum to 1.0 (#1067878, #1079080)
flags.detail: The per-venue 'weight' fields are published as collected (Pinnacle 0.36, Polymarket 0.24, Kalshi 0.18, Unibet 0.10 on #1067878, which sums to 0.88 because Bovada returned no price in that build; #1079080 is a single thin Polymarket venue published at 0.24). The published probability is the correctly normalised weighted mean of those quotes, so no probability is wrong: an independent re-derivation reproduces p0 for every market row within 0.01. The display is what is inconsistent, and a reader adding up the weights on the card would not get 100%.
flags.verification: re-derived 2026-10-24 with audit/session_5ff8e6bf/verify_published.py

flags.item: Pinnacle publishes each LoL series twice and the pick engine was using the (Kills) derivative
flags.detail: Pinnacle's guest API lists a series moneyline plus a parallel '(Kills)' market (e.g. 'Gen.G (Kills)' vs 'Invictus (Kills)'). In the 2026-10-23T11:42Z snapshot six of eight Worlds picks were taken from the (Kills) market: Gen.G vs Invictus Gaming carried 1.282/3.740 from matchup 1638758865 while the series market 1638748200 was 1.259/3.940. A kills derivative is not a series-winner price. Fixed in this build: tools/collect.py and tools/model.py now reject any participant name containing '(Kills)' or parentId derivatives, 8 derivative markets were excluded, and the 9 remaining market picks are all true series moneylines.
flags.verification: verified live 2026-10-23 (both matchup ids visible in one Pinnacle response)

flags.item: Fixture 1081423: four external sportsbooks contradict the published Elo pick by ~67 percentage points
flags.detail: Ground Zero Gaming vs Frank Esports (LCP 2027 Promotion Regional Merit BO5, 2026-11-11 09:00Z) is priced by our Elo line at Ground Zero Gaming 24.8% / Frank Esports 75.2% (Ground Zero Gaming effective 1508 across 48 series vs Frank Esports 1708 across 57 series). Independent live verification on 2026-10-25 across BMBETS's 60-bookmaker index confirms four real-money sportsbooks quote Ground Zero Gaming as an overwhelming favourite: bet365 1.03 / 9.10 (de-vigged 90.8% / 9.2%), TotoGaming 1.03 / 10.50 (91.1% / 8.9%), 1xBet 1.02 / 10.50 (91.2% / 8.8%) and BetOlimp 1.02 / 9.80 (90.6% / 9.4%), alongside EGamersWorld's index (1.025 / 10.50). Root cause verified against Liquipedia's LCP/2027/Promotion roster and Leaguepedia chronology: Ground Zero Gaming is the Tier-1 LCP 2026 incumbent (fielding Worlds veterans 1Jiang, Husha, Uniboy, Betty and Kaiwing), but entered the 25-month chronology in 2025 Tier-2 PCS (1575 prior) and then went 4-14 inside Tier-1 LCP 2026 against Worlds contenders CFO, Team Secret Whales and PSG Talon, whereas challenger Frank Esports accumulated a 24-9 record inside isolated Tier-2 PCS 2026 without facing Tier-1 LCP opposition. Because BMBETS/bet365 cannot be polled automatically from the GitHub Actions runner, the automated model pick is kept as-is per repository policy (archived/manual receipts never overwrite live pricing) and this structural Tier-1-incumbent vs Tier-2-challenger limitation is flagged prominently here and in data/corroboration.json.
flags.verification: verified live 2026-10-25 against BMBETS (bet365 1.03/9.10, TotoGaming 1.03/10.50, 1xBet 1.02/10.50, BetOlimp 1.02/9.80) and Liquipedia LCP/2027/Promotion Regional Merit roster

flags.item: RESOLVED 2026-10-24: the published list had been missing 20 live Hotspawn fixtures because refresh-picks failed four scheduled runs in a row
flags.detail: Historical finding, kept for the audit trail and re-verified as fixed. The canonical dataset had been frozen at 2026-10-23T17:11:12Z while Hotspawn had already rotated its scheduled list. Comparing the published rows with the fixtures API snapshot the secondary pipeline fetched on 2026-10-24T15:34:30Z: 20 fixtures on the live feed were absent from the published site - all eight Worlds 2026 Main Event cards for 2026-10-24/25, four 4 Nations 2026 Halloween Heist cards, three Komplettligaen 2026 Autumn Playoffs cards, four Logitech G SuperStrike Cup Qualifier cards and one RIVALS LEAGUE Season 2 card - and 20 published rows had already been played and left the feed. Cause: the publish gate 'external receipts validated against the dataset' treated a book receipt whose fixture had simply been played as a hard failure, so committing any receipt guaranteed a self-inflicted outage within about a day. Failed runs: 40026767003, 40063260000, 40088464687, 40109474033. Independently fixed on main (session 80c624cd / 1a46a678) by classifying such receipts as 'historic' rather than 'rejected', and re-verified here by session 62ba9cfe: audit/verify_gate_regression.py now reports 'published inventory 2026-10-24T16:32:05Z age 0.1 h fresh / MISSING 0 / NO LONGER ON HOTSPAWN 0 / rows without a pick 0 / verdict OK' against 241 rows. The new audit script keeps the two pipelines cross-checking each other so this cannot recur silently.
flags.verification: re-verified 2026-10-24T16:37Z by audit/verify_gate_regression.py (report committed at audit/gate_regression_report.json); the eight Worlds kick-off times were separately confirmed against bo3.gg and EGamersWorld, which list the same eight cards on 2026-10-24 at the same US Eastern times

flags.item: The 'displayed clock is UTC-4' note for bo3.gg and EGamersWorld is only correct until 2026-11-01
flags.detail: data/corroboration.json records both aggregators as 'Displayed clock is UTC-4 (US Eastern)'. Both actually display US Eastern local time, which is UTC-4 during EDT and UTC-5 during EST. US daylight saving ends on 2026-11-01, so from that date the same note is off by an hour and any receipt mapped with it lands on the wrong fixture. Verified both ways: 13:00 on 24.10.2026 (EDT) == 17:00Z, matching fixture 1067688; 00:00 on 10.11.2026 (EST) == 05:00Z, matching fixture 1081421; 04:00 on 11.11.2026 (EST) == 09:00Z, matching fixture 1081423. The correction is written into the receipt file header and into research/LONGTAIL_VENUES.md; the wording in data/corroboration.json is generated by tools/corroborate.py and is corrected there.
flags.verification: three independent fixture/page time pairs reconciled against the Hotspawn fixtures API on 2026-10-24; DST end date 2026-11-01 is the US federal rule (first Sunday in November)

flags.item: Hotspawn voids forfeited-match predictions (official rule) - Solid Gaming settlement picks are expected to score 0
flags.detail: Hotspawn's How Pick'ems Works page states: 'If a match is forfeited, all predictions for that match are voided. No points are awarded or deducted...' (checked 2026-10-24). The four Komplettligaen cards involving removed team Solid Gaming (#1071170, #1071200, #1071206, #1071186) therefore show the official forfeit winner with no probability, and the expected Hotspawn outcome is VOID (0 points whichever side is picked). The side shown matters only if Hotspawn grades a walkover instead of voiding. Site copy, model basis text and the Unresolved page were updated to cite this rule (session e32a5c4b); no pick value changed.
flags.verification: verified live 2026-10-24 (official Hotspawn help page, forfeited-match FAQ)

flags.item: A post-kickoff Kalshi settling price was published as a 99% pre-match pick (LYON vs Karmine Corp, Worlds 2026, id 1067684) [verified 2026-10-25 against data/raw/kalshi_lol.json, data/raw/hotspawn_lol.json and data/corroboration.json]
flags.detail: Hotspawn locked picks at 2026-10-24T19:55Z for a 20:00Z kick-off, but the Kalshi feed captured at 20:52:38Z showed LYON bid/ask 0.99/1.00 vs Karmine Corp 0.00/0.01 while LYON closed out an upset win, and the build published LYON 99% / Karmine Corp 1% as a single-venue market pick. Every pre-match source had LYON as underdog: bo3.gg 44.0%, Unibet/Kambi 45.7%, OddsPortal 44.9% (receipts in data/corroboration.json) and our Elo 39.7%; EGamersWorld records pre-match odds LYON 2.04 / Karmine Corp 1.71 and the 1-0 LYON result. The named winner coincided with the result, but the probability was false and unusable (captured 57 min after lock). Fixed 2026-10-25 (session 2faec1ff): any venue quote observed at/after kick-off is rejected, prediction-market sides >=97% are rejected like decimal extremes, every live feed must be <=24 h old, rejections are disclosed per row and in market_hygiene, and three publish gates plus six regression tests (tests/test_market_guards.py) block recurrence. The corrected row carries the originated line: Karmine Corp 60.3%.
flags.verification: verified 2026-10-25 against data/raw/kalshi_lol.json (fetched_utc 2026-10-24T20:52:38Z, bid/ask 0.99/1.00 vs 0.00/0.01), data/raw/hotspawn_lol.json (lock_utc 2026-10-24T19:55:00Z), data/corroboration.json pre-match receipts, and https://liquipedia.net/leagueoflegends/World_Championship/2026 (LYON 1:0 Karmine Corp)
